title: January 21, 2010 Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
transcript:
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Thursday, January 21, 2010
The Austin City Council will convene at 9:00 AM on
Thursday, January 21, 2010 at Austin City Hall,
Council Chambers
301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX

Mayor Lee Leffingwell
Mayor Pro Tern Mike Martinez
Council Member Chris Riley, Place 1
Council Member Randi Shade, Place 3
Council Member Laura Morrison, Place 4
Council Member William Spelman, Place 5
Council Member Sheryl Cole, Place 6
For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210
The City Council will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters,
to discuss or take action on a "competitive matter" of Austin Energy as provided for
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda.
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this
agenda.
Reading and Action on Consent Agenda
Action on the Following:
Ordinances / Resolutions / Motions -
All of the following items may be acted upon by one motion. No separate discussion
or action on any of the items is necessary unless desired by a Council Member.
9:00 AM — City Council Convenes
Item(s) to Set Public Hearing(s)
1. 
Set a public hearing to consider an ordinance creating an economic development
program for and authorizing the negotiation and execution of an Economic
Development Agreement with HANGER ORTHOPEDICS. (Suggested date and time:
January 28, 2010, 10:30 a.m. at Austin City Hall, 301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX).
9:00 AM -- Morning Briefings
2. 
Staff presentation regarding an economic development proposal to create an
economic development program for Hanger Orthopedics
Executive Session
3. 
Discuss legal issues regarding the City's disposal of scrap tires. (Private Consultation
with Attorney - Section 551.071)
Adjourn
